_comment: ZEYRECUITE source registry (F15). Set enabled=true and fill in slugs/keys to turn a source on. Company career pages (lever/ashby/workable/smartrecruiters/workday) need at least one slug. Adzuna needs a free api_key + api_id. The Muse needs a search query. companysite (Phase 4) scans the career pages of the companies you list; edit `sites` below to the companies you actually target.

companysite._comment: Phase 4 — company career pages. Replace these with the companies you target: the engine detects the ATS behind each page (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable/SmartRecruiters/Workday) and applications submit directly on the company site.
